audience: Chief or senior architect · integration lead · agency technical lead

videos.title: Place every component — the four functional layers
videos.message: Four functional layers — Service Access, Event Distribution, Trust and Security, Governance and Administration — give every component of the platform a place.

videos.title: Secure every call — the three trust zones
videos.message: Public, Member-Internal, Trust-Anchor — knowing which zone a call crosses tells you exactly what security it needs.

videos.title: Adopt the standards portfolio
videos.message: Adopt the published standards — REST/OpenAPI, OAuth/OIDC, mTLS, X-Road — instead of writing your own; the portfolio is the menu every member shares.

videos.title: Generate the semantic map
videos.message: Generate a semantic map so two agencies mean the same 'learner' before they exchange one — the hardest layer, made tractable.

videos.title: Generate a service contract
videos.message: Turn a service brief into an OpenAPI contract, then an X-Road service description — the configuration that puts a service on the bus.

videos.title: Put a real data source on the bus — the Giga case
videos.message: Take Giga's real school data through a bronze/silver/gold pipeline onto the bus — a worked exchange you can copy for your sector.

videos.title: Wire a service onto the bus
videos.message: The OpenAPI contract becomes an X-Road service description and the call resolves — the GovStack Information Mediation pattern.

videos.title: Make the exchange lawful — the data-protection envelope
videos.message: Letters of Interest plus a data-protection envelope make a real exchange lawful as well as technically possible.
